---
title: "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# Extract the 67 county precinct files into a temporary directory
tmp_dir <- tempdir()
files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = tmp_dir)

# Read only the office, candidate, party, and votes columns across all counties
gov_rep <- read_tsv(
  files,
  col_names = FALSE,
  col_select = c(office = 12, candidate = 15, party = 16, votes = 19),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(office == "Governor", party == "REP") |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = candidate)
```

```{r}
gov_rep |>
  mutate(candidate = fct_reorder(candidate, total_votes)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_votes, y = candidate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor",
    subtitle = "Official statewide vote totals by candidate",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
